acceptedBaseline: Current life-room R05 is a visual/behavior baseline only; no claim of production integration.
primaryDefect: Short single-task demos do not test a continuous multi-step resident routine with state handoff, object return, recovery, and measurable acceptance gates.
protectedInvariants: No changes to production body, rig, skin, animation, physics or assembly entry points
No direct bone writes from this experiment
Object ownership must survive rollback; cancellation while holding an object is deferred
Task success requires observation gates and finite motion/collision metrics
forbiddenRoutes: Claiming fake-adapter tests are live 3D or visual validation
Counting task completion without contact, support, collision and continuity checks
Silently dropping held objects on cancellation
acceptanceGates: 51-task routine can run two full cycles with 102 verified task results in deterministic contract test
A failed contact gate triggers bounded recovery and does not count as success
Cancellation while holding an object pauses and requests safe release
